title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.23574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. translated_title: Darwin-Claw：面向递归自进化智能体的环境自适应经验整合
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂任务中已展现出卓越的能力，但它们主要在孤立的会话中运行，缺乏从历史交互中持续学习或适应特定用户环境的能力。现有的自进化范式往往不加区分地将原始交互轨迹注入记忆或技能模块，导致行为模式模糊不清且更新可控性受损。此外，随着基础LLM推理能力的提升，智能体进化的瓶颈已从积累通用知识转向有效管理情境化经验。为解决这一问题，我们提出Darwin-Claw，这是一个环境自适应的自进化框架，它系统性地提炼情景经验，以驱动操作技能和持久记忆的全面进化。该框架在理论上基于“智能体-执行者”与“进化器-批评者”的迭代协同适应机制…
tldr: 提出Darwin-Claw，一个环境自适应的自进化框架，通过系统性地提炼情景经验，并基于“智能体-执行者”与“进化器-批评者”的迭代协同适应机制，驱动LLM智能体操作技能与持久记忆的全面进化。
en_tdlr: Darwin-Claw is an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experience through an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation mechanism, driving the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory in LLM agents.
